description: This file defines the 'UntellableStreamException' class within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace, representing specific exception cases related to stream position telling failures.

classes.name: UntellableStreamException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating stream position 'tell' operation failures, extending RuntimeException and implementing ExceptionInterface.

methods.name: dueToMissingResource
methods.description: Creates an exception instance indicating the absence of a resource, preventing tell operation.

methods.name: dueToPhpError
methods.description: Creates an exception instance indicating an error occurred during the tell operation.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Creates an exception instance indicating callback streams that cannot perform tell operations.

calls: new self('No resource available; cannot tell position')
new self('Error occurred during tell operation')
new self('Callback streams cannot tell position')
